metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the empty chair, the first line, one laugh, and a clap in the buttery.

yesterday: Nine was the house's hour and about ten was yours to Sam. You kept both.
She laughed once, at Pope. Kemp took three lines over and a lifted hand. The owl held the hall until the chair stirred.
Bryan called her seat as good as a purse. You refused to enter the night as paid.
My lord clapped your shoulder in the buttery and went out. Tomorrow is the lovers, and the voice stays under the note.
